svg.title: Figure 10 | Three stages of Kerberos ticket use
svg.desc: The first two stages show request and reply. In stage three the service checks authorization; access according to permissions is not a fixed AP reply packet. Mutual authentication can use AP_REP. AS/TGS are logical KDC functions; pre-authentication round trips, key details, and cache reuse are simplified.

g.text: Figure 10 | Three stages of Kerberos ticket use
→ Request an initial ticket and prove identity
→ Use the TGT to request a file-server ticket
→ Present the service ticket and Authenticator
After validation, access according to permissions
